question: Which of the following political parties has been leading the 'Mahajot' in Assam against the ruling party, ahead of the 2021 Assembly Elections in the state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian National Congress.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **10-party 'Mahajot' is an alliance led by the Indian National Congress, ahead of the 2021 Assembly Elections in the state.**
 
• The election saw the **BJP-led National Democratic Alliance (NDA) retaining power with 75 seats.**
 
• This is the **first time a non-INC alliance won consecutive terms** in the state.
 
• The** Mahajot led by INC won 50 seats, increasing its tally from 26 in 2016.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The **Mahajot** had six parties when it was formally announced on **January 19, 2021.**
 
• Now there are 10 parties in the Mahajot alliance. These were:
 
 
• **the Congress.**
 
• **the All India United Democratic Front (AIUDF).**
 
• **the Communist Party of India, CPI (Marxist).**
 
• **the CPI (Marxist-Leninist).**
 
• **the Anchalik Gana Morcha.**
 
• **the Bodoland People’s Front (BPF).**
 
• **the Rashtriya Janata Dal.**
 
• **the Jimochayan (Deori) People’s Party, or JDPP.**
 
• **the Adivasi National Party (ANP).**
